items.ask: Is this message real? 'Your SBI account will be blocked today. Update KYC at sbi-kyc-update.in'
items.card:
SCAM ALERT
- sbi-kyc-update.in is not SBI. SBI's sites are sbi.co.in and onlinesbi.sbi
- Do not tap the link or share OTP, PIN or card details
- Report: 1930 or cybercrime.gov.in
